How to play

Goal: be first to complete a hand of 4 sets + 1 pair (14 tiles). A set is a pong (3 of a kind), a chow (a run of 3 in one suit), or a kong (4 of a kind).

  • Your turn: you draw automatically — tap any tile in your hand to discard it. One tap is all it takes, and there's no time limit.
  • Pong: if any player discards a tile you hold 2 of, claim it to complete the set face-up, then discard.
  • Kong: claim a discard you hold 3 of (or declare 4 of a kind in your own hand), then draw a replacement tile.
  • Chow: only the player after the discarder can claim, and only to complete a run.
  • Win: claim any discard that completes your hand, or win on your own draw. There is no timer — take as long as you like to decide. Tapping Pass lets play move on.

Scoring (points): base win 30 · self-drawn +15 · dealer win +15 · honor set (dragon/wind, face-up) +15 each · all pongs +30 · all simples +15 · half flush +30 · full flush +60. On a discard win the discarder pays the full amount; on a self-drawn win everyone pays a third.

Tiles: Dots, Bamboo and Characters run 1–9; Winds are East, South, West, North; Dragons are Red, Green and White. Everyone starts on 1,000 points. If the wall runs out, the hand is a draw and the deal passes on.
